question: A rollout uses minReadySeconds=60. New pods have been Ready for 15 seconds; old replicas remain and no errors appear.

options.A: Wait for the availability interval before judging rollout failure.
options.B: Treat Ready replicas as immediately available and delete old replicas.

criteria: Ready is not Available until minReadySeconds elapses.
correct_text: Wait for the availability interval before judging rollout failure.
incorrect_text: Treat Ready replicas as immediately available and delete old replicas.

question: A Service selects two pods. EndpointSlice lists only one ready endpoint; the other pod is Running but readiness fails. Requests reach only one pod.

options.A: Change the Service selector to include the Running pod before investigating probes.
options.B: Investigate the failing readiness probe before changing Service selectors.

criteria: Running does not imply ready; the selector already matches both.
correct_text: Investigate the failing readiness probe before changing Service selectors.
incorrect_text: Change the Service selector to include the Running pod before investigating probes.

question: A pod requests 2 CPU. A node has 4 allocatable CPU, 3 already requested, and actual usage 0.4 CPU. Scheduler reports insufficient CPU.

options.A: Free or resize CPU requests, or add allocatable capacity.
options.B: Reduce actual CPU utilization without changing requests or capacity.

criteria: Scheduling uses requests against allocatable capacity.
correct_text: Free or resize CPU requests, or add allocatable capacity.
incorrect_text: Reduce actual CPU utilization without changing requests or capacity.

question: A pod tolerates a NoSchedule taint but has required node affinity for zone A; all available nodes are zone B.

options.A: Add another toleration to make zone B nodes eligible.
options.B: Resolve required node affinity or provide eligible zone A capacity.

criteria: Tolerations do not override required affinity.
correct_text: Resolve required node affinity or provide eligible zone A capacity.
incorrect_text: Add another toleration to make zone B nodes eligible.

question: A CronJob has concurrencyPolicy Forbid; its previous Job is still active when the next schedule arrives.

options.A: Investigate the active Job and skipped schedule.
options.B: Investigate image pulling as the established cause of the skipped schedule.

criteria: Forbid skips concurrent execution; no image pull evidence.
correct_text: Investigate the active Job and skipped schedule.
incorrect_text: Investigate image pulling as the established cause of the skipped schedule.

question: A Deployment has replicas=3, HPA minimum=2 maximum=10, current desired=7; GitOps reapplies replicas=3 every minute.

options.A: Increase HPA maximum while retaining periodic replica resets.
options.B: Resolve competing replica ownership between GitOps and HPA.

criteria: Both controllers write desired replica count.
correct_text: Resolve competing replica ownership between GitOps and HPA.
incorrect_text: Increase HPA maximum while retaining periodic replica resets.

question: A container exits with code 0 after completing a one-shot task; Deployment restartPolicy Always causes repeated restarts.

options.A: Use a Job if the workload is intended to terminate successfully.
options.B: Increase memory limits to prevent the successful process exit.

criteria: Exit zero and Always restart fit a one-shot workload mismatch.
correct_text: Use a Job if the workload is intended to terminate successfully.
incorrect_text: Increase memory limits to prevent the successful process exit.

question: A NetworkPolicy selects a server and allows ingress from namespace label team=blue. Client namespace is labeled team=green; DNS resolves and TCP times out. No other ingress policies apply.

options.A: Change DNS records to resolve the existing Service address again.
options.B: Check the namespace selector against the intended access policy.

criteria: Ingress policy excludes the client; DNS already resolves.
correct_text: Check the namespace selector against the intended access policy.
incorrect_text: Change DNS records to resolve the existing Service address again.

question: A PVC is Bound to a local PV with node affinity node A. Pod requires node B and scheduler reports volume node affinity conflict.

options.A: Reconcile pod placement with the local volume affinity.
options.B: Increase requested storage capacity while retaining incompatible placement.

criteria: Bound local storage constrains placement.
correct_text: Reconcile pod placement with the local volume affinity.
incorrect_text: Increase requested storage capacity while retaining incompatible placement.

question: A pod has a startup probe that has not succeeded; liveness failure threshold would otherwise be exceeded. Startup probe is still within its failure budget.

options.A: Attribute the current startup delay to active liveness probe failures.
options.B: Investigate startup probe progress before attributing restarts to liveness.

criteria: Startup probe gates liveness and readiness until success.
correct_text: Investigate startup probe progress before attributing restarts to liveness.
incorrect_text: Attribute the current startup delay to active liveness probe failures.

question: A container publishes 8080:80. The process listens on 127.0.0.1:80 inside the container; host requests fail while container loopback works.

options.A: Publish another host port while retaining the loopback-only listener.
options.B: Bind the process to an appropriate container interface.

criteria: Port publishing cannot reach a loopback-only listener via container IP.
correct_text: Bind the process to an appropriate container interface.
incorrect_text: Publish another host port while retaining the loopback-only listener.

question: A build copies package manifests then runs npm ci, then copies source. Only source changes and dependency layer is cached.

options.A: Keep dependency caching and inspect the later source build step.
options.B: Invalidate dependency caching because every source edit changes the manifest layer.

criteria: Earlier layers remain reusable when their inputs are unchanged.
correct_text: Keep dependency caching and inspect the later source build step.
incorrect_text: Invalidate dependency caching because every source edit changes the manifest layer.

question: A bind mount over /app hides files baked into the image; removing the mount reveals them.

options.A: Rebuild the image to restore files while retaining the same masking mount.
options.B: Inspect the host mount contents and destination.

criteria: Bind mount obscures image contents at its destination.
correct_text: Inspect the host mount contents and destination.
incorrect_text: Rebuild the image to restore files while retaining the same masking mount.

question: A container uses --memory=512m and reports OOMKilled=true; host has 20 GB free.

options.A: Inspect container memory usage against its cgroup limit.
options.B: Increase host free memory without changing the container limit.

criteria: Container limit can trigger OOM despite host headroom.
correct_text: Inspect container memory usage against its cgroup limit.
incorrect_text: Increase host free memory without changing the container limit.

question: An amd64-only image is run on arm64 without emulation; executable fails with exec format error.

options.A: Change published ports to match the executable architecture.
options.B: Use a compatible architecture image or configured emulation.

criteria: Executable architecture mismatch explains the error.
correct_text: Use a compatible architecture image or configured emulation.
incorrect_text: Change published ports to match the executable architecture.

question: Two Compose services share a network. Client connects to localhost:5432 but database listens in the other container.

options.A: Use the database service name and container port.
options.B: Use localhost and publish a different database host port.

criteria: Container localhost refers to itself.
correct_text: Use the database service name and container port.
incorrect_text: Use localhost and publish a different database host port.

question: A multi-stage build compiles a binary in stage builder but final stage copies only configuration; runtime says binary missing.

options.A: Install more compiler dependencies in builder without changing final copy.
options.B: Copy the binary into the final stage and verify its path.

criteria: Artifacts do not automatically transfer between stages.
correct_text: Copy the binary into the final stage and verify its path.
incorrect_text: Install more compiler dependencies in builder without changing final copy.

question: A container runs as UID 1001; mounted directory is owned by UID 1000 with mode 0700. Root filesystem is writable.

options.A: Adjust mount permissions or runtime identity appropriately.
options.B: Make the image filesystem writable again without changing mount permissions.

criteria: Host mount permissions deny UID 1001.
correct_text: Adjust mount permissions or runtime identity appropriately.
incorrect_text: Make the image filesystem writable again without changing mount permissions.

question: A healthcheck fails but PID 1 remains running. Standalone Docker restart policy is on-failure.

options.A: Expect on-failure to restart the container solely because health is unhealthy.
options.B: Investigate healthcheck and application behavior separately from exit-based restart policy.

criteria: Standalone restart policy responds to process exit, not health status alone.
correct_text: Investigate healthcheck and application behavior separately from exit-based restart policy.
incorrect_text: Expect on-failure to restart the container solely because health is unhealthy.

question: A tag latest was updated remotely; an existing container still uses the old image ID after docker restart.

options.A: Pull the updated image and recreate the container.
options.B: Restart the existing container again to replace its image ID.

criteria: Restart does not recreate from a newer image.
correct_text: Pull the updated image and recreate the container.
incorrect_text: Restart the existing container again to replace its image ID.

question: A pipeline stashes files on agent A and later uses agent B with an empty workspace; no unstash step exists.

options.A: Unstash the artifacts on agent B before consuming them.
options.B: Retry the consumer on agent B without transferring artifacts.

criteria: Stash requires explicit unstash in the destination workspace.
correct_text: Unstash the artifacts on agent B before consuming them.
incorrect_text: Retry the consumer on agent B without transferring artifacts.

question: A shell script runs tests piped to tee; shell lacks pipefail and tee exits zero while tests exit nonzero.

options.A: Treat the successful tee exit as proof that tests passed.
options.B: Preserve the test exit status using suitable shell handling.

criteria: Pipeline status can be the last command status.
correct_text: Preserve the test exit status using suitable shell handling.
incorrect_text: Treat the successful tee exit as proof that tests passed.

question: A parallel stage writes two branches to the same shared output path; each passes alone but concurrent runs corrupt files.

options.A: Isolate branch output paths or synchronize shared writes.
options.B: Increase parallelism while retaining the shared output path.

criteria: Concurrent writes explain interference.
correct_text: Isolate branch output paths or synchronize shared writes.
incorrect_text: Increase parallelism while retaining the shared output path.

question: A build is queued with label linux-arm; idle agents all have label linux-x86 only.

options.A: Increase executors on agents that still lack the required label.
options.B: Provide a matching agent or correct the label requirement.

criteria: Executor availability does not satisfy label constraints.
correct_text: Provide a matching agent or correct the label requirement.
incorrect_text: Increase executors on agents that still lack the required label.

question: A credential is scoped to folder A; job in folder B cannot resolve its ID; network connectivity works.

options.A: Check credential scope and authorized job access.
options.B: Retry network connectivity without changing credential visibility.

criteria: Folder scope limits credential resolution.
correct_text: Check credential scope and authorized job access.
incorrect_text: Retry network connectivity without changing credential visibility.

question: A declarative pipeline uses skipDefaultCheckout and invokes a build in a fresh workspace without checkout scm.

options.A: Increase build timeout while leaving the workspace empty.
options.B: Perform explicit source checkout before building.

criteria: Default checkout was intentionally disabled.
correct_text: Perform explicit source checkout before building.
incorrect_text: Increase build timeout while leaving the workspace empty.

question: A stage has catchError configured to continue after a failed command and mark the build unstable. Deployment later runs.

options.A: Gate deployment explicitly on the required build result.
options.B: Assume catchError automatically prevents every later stage.

criteria: catchError allows execution to continue.
correct_text: Gate deployment explicitly on the required build result.
incorrect_text: Assume catchError automatically prevents every later stage.

question: A pipeline uses a stage-level timeout; agent provisioning consumes most of that timeout before steps begin.

options.A: Measure only shell runtime when explaining the stage timeout.
options.B: Account for agent allocation in the stage timeout.

criteria: Stage-level timeout includes agent allocation in declarative pipelines.
correct_text: Account for agent allocation in the stage timeout.
incorrect_text: Measure only shell runtime when explaining the stage timeout.

question: A Maven build uses an offline flag and a fresh agent cache; a required dependency is absent locally.

options.A: Populate the dependency cache or allow approved repository access.
options.B: Change Java heap size while keeping the dependency unavailable offline.

criteria: Offline resolution requires cached dependencies.
correct_text: Populate the dependency cache or allow approved repository access.
incorrect_text: Change Java heap size while keeping the dependency unavailable offline.

question: A downstream job is triggered with wait=false; upstream succeeds before downstream fails.

options.A: Interpret upstream success as confirmation of downstream success.
options.B: Track downstream result explicitly or wait for completion.

criteria: Asynchronous triggering does not establish downstream result.
correct_text: Track downstream result explicitly or wait for completion.
incorrect_text: Interpret upstream success as confirmation of downstream success.

question: df shows filesystem full; du totals much less; lsof shows a large deleted file held open by a process.

options.A: Delete the already unlinked pathname again to reclaim its blocks.
options.B: Arrange safe release of the open deleted file.

criteria: Blocks remain allocated until final open reference closes.
correct_text: Arrange safe release of the open deleted file.
incorrect_text: Delete the already unlinked pathname again to reclaim its blocks.

question: df -h shows free blocks but df -i shows zero free inodes; creating a tiny file fails ENOSPC.

options.A: Free inodes or expand inode capacity where supported.
options.B: Free only data blocks while leaving inode exhaustion unchanged.

criteria: File creation needs an inode.
correct_text: Free inodes or expand inode capacity where supported.
incorrect_text: Free only data blocks while leaving inode exhaustion unchanged.

question: Load average is high, CPU mostly idle, many tasks in uninterruptible sleep, storage latency elevated.

options.A: Treat load average as direct proof of CPU saturation.
options.B: Investigate blocked I/O and storage latency.

criteria: Linux load includes uninterruptible tasks.
correct_text: Investigate blocked I/O and storage latency.
incorrect_text: Treat load average as direct proof of CPU saturation.

question: A systemd service reads an environment file at startup; file was edited but process environment is unchanged.

options.A: Restart the service safely to read the new environment.
options.B: Run daemon-reload alone and expect existing process environment to change.

criteria: Existing process environment does not update from file edits.
correct_text: Restart the service safely to read the new environment.
incorrect_text: Run daemon-reload alone and expect existing process environment to change.

question: A file is mode 0644 and owned by the user, but a parent directory lacks execute permission for that user; opening fails.

options.A: Add file read permission while retaining blocked directory traversal.
options.B: Restore appropriate directory traversal permission.

criteria: Path traversal requires directory execute permission.
correct_text: Restore appropriate directory traversal permission.
incorrect_text: Add file read permission while retaining blocked directory traversal.

question: A filesystem is mounted read-only after errors; root cannot create files despite permissive directory modes.

options.A: Investigate filesystem errors and safe recovery before remounting.
options.B: Change directory permissions while retaining read-only mount.

criteria: Read-only mount blocks writes independently of mode bits.
correct_text: Investigate filesystem errors and safe recovery before remounting.
incorrect_text: Change directory permissions while retaining read-only mount.

question: A process is killed by a memory cgroup; system-wide free memory remains high and cgroup memory.events oom_kill increases.

options.A: Attribute the event to proven system-wide memory exhaustion.
options.B: Inspect the cgroup memory limit and workload usage.

criteria: Cgroup OOM can occur without global OOM.
correct_text: Inspect the cgroup memory limit and workload usage.
incorrect_text: Attribute the event to proven system-wide memory exhaustion.

question: A service listens on IPv6 loopback ::1 only; IPv4 client uses 127.0.0.1 and receives connection refused.

options.A: Check listener address family and bind configuration.
options.B: Change DNS resolver settings for the literal IPv4 address.

criteria: Literal address bypasses DNS; listener is on different family.
correct_text: Check listener address family and bind configuration.
incorrect_text: Change DNS resolver settings for the literal IPv4 address.

question: A shell command is found in an interactive session but not in cron; cron PATH excludes its directory.

options.A: Change executable permissions despite successful interactive execution.
options.B: Use an explicit executable path or configure cron PATH.

criteria: Different PATH explains command lookup failure.
correct_text: Use an explicit executable path or configure cron PATH.
incorrect_text: Change executable permissions despite successful interactive execution.

question: A process writes to a log after rotation by rename; new log stays empty and old inode grows.

options.A: Configure supported log reopening after rotation.
options.B: Rename the new empty log again without reopening the process descriptor.

criteria: Open descriptor continues pointing to old inode.
correct_text: Configure supported log reopening after rotation.
incorrect_text: Rename the new empty log again without reopening the process descriptor.

question: An IAM role allows s3:GetObject but a bucket policy explicitly denies the same principal and object; no exceptions match.

options.A: Resolve the applicable explicit deny through authorized policy review.
options.B: Add another identity allow for the same denied request.

criteria: Explicit deny overrides allow.
correct_text: Resolve the applicable explicit deny through authorized policy review.
incorrect_text: Add another identity allow for the same denied request.

question: An EC2 instance in a private subnet has route to NAT gateway; NAT public subnet lacks route to internet gateway.

options.A: Add another private subnet NAT route while leaving NAT egress broken.
options.B: Restore the required public subnet internet gateway route.

criteria: Public NAT needs internet gateway connectivity.
correct_text: Restore the required public subnet internet gateway route.
incorrect_text: Add another private subnet NAT route while leaving NAT egress broken.

question: An ALB target group health check uses /health on port 8080; app serves /ready on 8080 and /health returns 404; matcher is 200.

options.A: Align health check path with the intended readiness endpoint.
options.B: Increase target capacity while retaining the failing health path.

criteria: Health matcher rejects 404.
correct_text: Align health check path with the intended readiness endpoint.
incorrect_text: Increase target capacity while retaining the failing health path.

question: A security group permits inbound HTTPS; subnet NACL permits inbound 443 but denies outbound ephemeral response ports. TCP handshake fails.

options.A: Add another inbound security group rule without fixing NACL return path.
options.B: Review stateless NACL return-path rules.

criteria: NACL is stateless and must allow return traffic.
correct_text: Review stateless NACL return-path rules.
incorrect_text: Add another inbound security group rule without fixing NACL return path.

question: An SQS standard queue delivers a message twice; consumer deleted first receipt after processing but duplicate still arrives.

options.A: Make processing idempotent for at-least-once delivery.
options.B: Assume successful deletion guarantees no duplicate processing.

criteria: Standard queues provide at-least-once delivery.
correct_text: Make processing idempotent for at-least-once delivery.
incorrect_text: Assume successful deletion guarantees no duplicate processing.

question: An Auto Scaling group desired=4 maximum=4; scaling alarm requests more capacity while all four instances are healthy.

options.A: Raise desired capacity above the unchanged maximum.
options.B: Review maximum capacity and scaling policy constraints.

criteria: Maximum bounds desired capacity.
correct_text: Review maximum capacity and scaling policy constraints.
incorrect_text: Raise desired capacity above the unchanged maximum.

question: A Lambda function in a VPC public subnet has no public IP and no NAT route; calls to a public API time out.

options.A: Provide appropriate outbound connectivity such as NAT for IPv4.
options.B: Rely on the public subnet internet gateway route alone.

criteria: VPC Lambda ENIs do not receive public IPs.
correct_text: Provide appropriate outbound connectivity such as NAT for IPv4.
incorrect_text: Rely on the public subnet internet gateway route alone.

question: An EBS volume is in AZ A; replacement EC2 instance is in AZ B; direct attachment fails.

options.A: Retry direct attachment across availability zones.
options.B: Use same-AZ placement or restore a snapshot to a volume in AZ B.

criteria: EBS volume attachment is AZ constrained.
correct_text: Use same-AZ placement or restore a snapshot to a volume in AZ B.
incorrect_text: Retry direct attachment across availability zones.

question: A CloudWatch alarm treats missing data as notBreaching; metric publishing stops and alarm remains OK.

options.A: Check metric publication and missing-data treatment.
options.B: Interpret OK as proof the workload is currently healthy.

criteria: Missing data policy can mask absent telemetry.
correct_text: Check metric publication and missing-data treatment.
incorrect_text: Interpret OK as proof the workload is currently healthy.

question: An S3 presigned URL was signed with temporary role credentials that expired before the URL expiration timestamp.

options.A: Extend only the URL expiration while retaining expired signing credentials.
options.B: Generate a new URL with valid credentials and suitable lifetime.

criteria: Presigned URL cannot outlive underlying temporary credentials.
correct_text: Generate a new URL with valid credentials and suitable lifetime.
incorrect_text: Extend only the URL expiration while retaining expired signing credentials.
